notes: Peru: Lima (Miraflores, San Isidro-adjacent, Surco, La Molina, San Borja, Lince, Callao, north Lima), Trujillo, Cusco, Arequipa, Iquitos covered partially. No national duty rota or animal poison line found on official pages (CMVP and SENASA pages have none).
